The '''Mission to Aaris III''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' responded to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team [[MS-133]].
